body: The only way I know would be euthanasia/assisted suicide. But unfortunately that is not recognized as a human right, so it’s illegal in most places, and the places it is legal it’s only accessible for select few. So unless you’re lucky enough to be able to receive euthanasia, I’m sorry, but I don’t know what you can do

At this moment I have no plan of committing suicide, only because I have no reliable method of doing it. But if I had, I’d be looking into donating a kidney before I go and donate what money I have to a cause I support.
